source_text: Cantemus Domino: equum et ascensorem proiecit in mare. Homines insequentes equi sunt; habent ascensores — daemonia vel vitia. Christus equitatum salutis mittit. Qui Deum suum cognoscit, glorificat; qui et Patrem, exaltat.
pass_a_gloss: Let-us-sing to-Lord: horse and rider he-threw into sea. Humans pursuing horses are; they-have riders — demons or vices. Christ cavalry of-salvation sends. Who God his recognizes, glorifies; who also Father, exalts.
pass_b_english: [[Let us sing to the Lord: horse and rider he has thrown into the sea >> Bible:Exodus 15:1]]. Those who chase us are “horses”; they carry riders — demonic powers or reigning vices. Christ sends a [[cavalry of salvation >> Bible:Habakkuk 3:8]]. Know God as yours and glorify him; know him as Father and exalt him — [[that all may honor the Son as they honor the Father >> Bible:John 5:23]].
